compiled_state.title: Implement ticket-scratch-set.sh with atomic-write crash-safety
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: `scratch set` writes JSON envelope using atomic same-directory temp + fsync (with crash-between-write-and-rename behavioral test asserting no corrupt envelope visible to concurrent readers)

## Description

Create plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-set.sh. Reads stdin (or --value flag) for payload; wraps in envelope `{ts:<iso8601>,value:<payload>}`; calls `_scratch_resolve_and_validate` then `_scratch_atomic_write`. Exits 0 on success with `{status:"ok",ticket_id,key}` on stdout. Propagates structured error envelopes from helpers on failure with non-zero exit.

The crash-safety test simulates a crash between tempfile write and rename via a `DSO_TEST_CRASH=1` env-gated debug hook OR a kill -9 of a child python writer. After the abort, assert (a) the target envelope path either does not exist OR contains a complete prior-version envelope (never a partial write), and (b) no `*.tmp.*` sibling is visible to a concurrent reader.

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)

Given a ticket id and key with payload `"hello"`; When `dso ticket scratch set` runs; Then exit code is 0, stdout is `{status:"ok",ticket_id,key}`, and the file contains a JSON envelope with `ts` and `value:"hello"`. Given an existing valid envelope; When a second `scratch set` aborts between write and rename; Then a concurrent reader observes either the prior envelope unchanged OR the new envelope intact — never partial — AND no `*.tmp.*` file remains visible after the aborted process exits.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: N/A (no format_check command configured)
- [ ] scratch set emits `{status:"ok",ticket_id,key}` and writes envelope with `ts` + `value`
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-set.sh
- [ ] Crash between write and rename leaves either prior envelope intact or new envelope intact (never partial)
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-set.sh
- [ ] New script and test are executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-set.sh && test -x tests/scratch/test-scratch-set.sh

## File Impact

| Path | Action |
|------|--------|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-scratch-set.sh | Create |
| tests/scratch/test-scratch-set.sh | Create |

## Retry Budget

MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
